_about: This is a writer's starter template for a new seed. Copy this directory's contents to lore/seeds/<your-seed-name>/, rename seed.template.json to seed.json, fill in the placeholders, and write your lore .md files. See /seed_template.json at the plugin root and /schemas/README.md for the full contract.
_notes: Korean (or other non-ASCII) names go in the 'name' field, not the id.
game_id must be globally unique. Convention: <seed-name>-<era>.
Cross-references (ruler_id, controller_id, location_id) must point to existing entity ids.

entities._example_type: faction (player nation — copy this block per nation)
entities.name: <Display name, e.g. '고구려 (Goguryeo)'>

attributes.ruler_id: <character id, or null if no central ruler>
